cards.english_title: A Veteran Investigator Is Set to Lead Korea’s Tax Agency
cards.korean_desc: 이 대통령은 2026년 11월 6일 안덕수를 지명했다. 안 후보는 탈세와 주가 조사를 맡았다. 그는 1996년 공무원 시험에 합격했다. 그는 2026년 7월부터 서울청장이다.
cards.english_desc: President Lee nominated Ahn Duk-su to lead South Korea’s National Tax Service on November 6, 2026. Ahn is known for investigating tax evasion, stock manipulation and property-related tax dodging. He began public service after passing the national civil service exam in 1996. He has headed the Seoul Regional Tax Office since July 2026.
cards.hook: A veteran investigator is set to lead Korea’s tax agency.
cards.takeaway_english: The next test is whether experience becomes fair, understandable tax administration.

why_it_matters.english: Tax decisions affect households, companies and people facing unfair trading or property-tax practices.
why_it_matters.korean: 세금 결정은 가정과 기업에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Ahn’s record suggests investigations may remain central to the agency’s work.
why_it_matters.korean: 안 후보의 경력은 조사를 중시함을 보여준다.

parties.label: 안덕수
parties.english: He is nominated to lead the National Tax Service after decades in tax administration.

parties.label: 국세청
parties.english: The agency will be led by a former investigator known for tax-evasion cases.

parties.label: 납세자
parties.english: Taxpayers may see stronger attention to rights and unfair tax practices.
parties.korean: 납세자 권리 관심이 커질 수 있다.

views.label: 대통령실
views.english: Ahn’s long experience should help fair taxation and protect taxpayers’ rights.
views.korean: 안 후보의 경험은 공정한 세정을 도울 것이다.

views.label: 비판적 관점
views.english: His record is clear, but the appointment gives little detail about broader policy challenges.

disagree.english: Supporters stress expertise, while critics may want clearer plans beyond investigations.
disagree.korean: 지지자는 전문성을, 비판자는 계획을 중시할 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Korean Retailers Chase Tourists Beyond Seoul
cards.korean_desc: 한국 유통업체들이 지방으로 확장한다. 지방 공항 입국자는 9개월에 37% 늘었다. 신세계는 부산 건물 두 개를 연결한다. 외국인 관광객은 부산에서 1조 원 넘게 썼다.
cards.english_desc: Korean retailers are expanding beyond Seoul as foreign tourists visit regional cities. Regional-airport arrivals rose about 37 percent to roughly 3.24 million in nine months. Shinsegae plans to connect two Busan buildings into a tourist retail complex. Foreign tourists spent over 1 trillion won in Busan from January through September.
cards.hook: Regional airports rose 37 percent as shoppers spread out.
cards.takeaway_english: Korean retail is turning regional tourism into a high-stakes location battle.
cards.takeaway_korean: 한국 유통업계의 지방 경쟁이 커지고 있다.

why_it_matters.english: More tourist spending outside Seoul could create new jobs and business opportunities in regional cities.
why_it_matters.korean: 지방 관광 지출은 새 일자리를 만들 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Travelers may find more shopping choices without returning to the capital.
why_it_matters.korean: 여행자는 서울 밖에서도 더 많이 쇼핑할 수 있다.

parties.label: 신세계
parties.english: It plans a large Shinsegae Town complex beside its Centum City store.

parties.label: 롯데
parties.english: It will sell one Busan branch and invest in other stores.
parties.korean: 롯데는 한 지점을 팔고 다른 곳에 투자한다.

parties.label: 올리브영
parties.english: It is opening large, locally themed stores outside the capital area.

views.label: Retail industry
views.english: Regional stores can become brand hubs when tourists arrive outside Seoul.
views.korean: 지방 매장은 관광객의 브랜드 거점이 될 수 있다.

views.label: Critical view
views.english: The boom may not help every region because Seoul still captures much tourist spending.
views.korean: 서울은 여전히 관광 지출을 많이 차지한다.

disagree.english: New stores may spread visitors, but the coverage gives limited evidence about long-term local benefits.
disagree.korean: 새 매장이 지역에 오래 도움 될지는 아직 모른다.

cards.english_title: Why Travelers Are Choosing Korea’s Slow Trains
cards.korean_desc: 한국 관광열차는 KTX보다 느리다. 풍경을 좋아하면 느린 열차가 더 좋다. V트레인은 87킬로미터 길에서 계곡을 지난다. V트레인은 목요일부터 월요일까지 하루 한 번 운행한다.
cards.english_desc: South Korea’s sightseeing trains offer scenic trips slower than the KTX. For scenery lovers, the slower trains can be the better trip. The V-train passes valleys, cliffs, farms and villages along an 87-kilometer route. The V-train runs once daily from Thursday through Monday.
cards.hook: Could Korea’s slow trains be the better autumn trip?
cards.korean_hook: 느린 기차가 더 좋은 가을 여행일까?
cards.takeaway_english: Korea’s slow trains turn the journey itself into the destination.
cards.takeaway_korean: 한국 느린 열차는 여정도 여행으로 만든다.

why_it_matters.english: The trains connect travelers with mountain villages that cars cannot easily reach.
why_it_matters.korean: 열차는 차로 가기 힘든 마을을 연결한다.

why_it_matters.english: Travelers can choose a trip built around scenery instead of speed.
why_it_matters.korean: 여행자는 속도보다 풍경을 고를 수 있다.

parties.label: V-train
parties.english: It travels from Yeongju to Cheoram through the Taebaek Mountains.

parties.label: A-train
parties.english: It links Jecheon with Auraji through the Baekdudaegan mountain range.

parties.label: 지역 마을
parties.english: Villages near stations gain transport, visitors and small local sales.
parties.korean: 역 주변 마을은 교통과 손님을 얻는다.

views.label: Scenery-focused travelers
views.english: The slower pace is the attraction because passengers can watch the landscape change.

views.label: Time-focused travelers
views.english: KTX remains more practical for people who need to cross Korea quickly.

disagree.english: Slow trains offer scenery, but their limited schedules make them less flexible than ordinary trains.
disagree.korean: 느린 열차는 운행 횟수가 적어 덜 편리하다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 더 좋은 풍경을 위해 속도를 포기할래요?

cards.reader_question: Would you trade speed for a better view?

cards.english_title: Lions Lead Bullpen Battle Despite Missing Their Closer
cards.korean_desc: 삼성 불펜은 11이닝 평균자책점 2.45를 기록했다. KT 불펜은 5.63, 박영현은 두 번 5아웃을 맡았다. 배찬승은 2차전 첫 포스트시즌 세이브를 기록했다.
cards.english_desc: Samsung's bullpen posted a 2.45 ERA across 11 innings. KT's bullpen posted a 5.63 ERA, while Park Yeong-hyun worked five outs twice. Bae Chan-seung earned his first postseason save in Game 2.
cards.hook: The Lions' bullpen has a 2.45 ERA.
cards.takeaway_english: The bullpen edge belongs to Samsung for now, but a best-of-seven series can turn quickly.
cards.takeaway_korean: 현재 불펜 우위는 삼성이지만 7전 시리즈는 빠르게 바뀔 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: Relief pitchers protect leads when games reach their most tense innings.
why_it_matters.korean: 불펜 투수는 경기가 가장 긴박한 이닝에서 리드를 지킨다.

why_it_matters.english: The Lions are missing their league-leading closer for the postseason.

parties.label: Samsung Lions
parties.english: Their relievers have allowed fewer earned runs through two games.
parties.korean: 불펜 투수들이 두 경기에서 자책점을 적게 내줬다.

parties.label: KT Wiz
parties.english: Their bullpen has a 5.63 ERA after two games.

parties.label: Bae Chan-seung
parties.english: The 20-year-old left-hander earned his first postseason save in Game 2.
parties.korean: 20살 왼손 투수 배찬승은 2차전 첫 포스트시즌 세이브를 기록했다.

views.label: Samsung's advantage
views.english: The Lions' deeper relief work has protected them despite Kim Jae-yoon's injury.
views.korean: 라이온즈는 김재윤의 부상에도 다양한 불펜을 활용했다.

views.label: KT's risk
views.english: The Wiz have depended heavily on Park Yeong-hyun for five outs each game.
views.korean: KT는 매 경기 박영현에게 아웃카운트 5개를 맡겼다.

disagree.english: Two games are a small sample, and starting pitchers or later games can change the balance.
disagree.korean: 두 경기는 짧은 표본이라 선발과 다음 경기가 흐름을 바꿀 수 있다.

cards.english_title: HYBE Defends NewJeans Contracts After Leak
cards.korean_desc: 하이브는 11월 6일 뉴진스 계약을 방어했다. 조사는 2022년 다섯 멤버의 미성년 계약을 살폈다. 하이브는 2022년 4월 전 협상이 거의 석 달 걸렸다고 말했다. 민희진 측은 하이브 법무팀이 초안과 수정을 이끌었다고 말했다.
cards.english_desc: HYBE defended NewJeans contracts on November 6 after a New York Times investigation. The investigation examined terms signed in 2022, when all five members were minors. HYBE said negotiations lasted nearly three months before signing in April 2022. Min Hee-jin's representatives said HYBE's legal team led drafting and revisions.
cards.hook: HYBE defended contracts signed when NewJeans members were minors.
cards.takeaway_english: The public dispute is now about both contract fairness and who shaped the documents.
cards.takeaway_korean: 공개 논쟁은 계약 공정성과 문서 작성자를 함께 다룬다.

why_it_matters.english: The contracts affect control over work, images, voices, penalties, and young performers' choices.
why_it_matters.korean: 계약은 활동, 이미지, 목소리, 위약금, 어린 가수의 선택에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: The dispute shows how unclear responsibility can deepen a company conflict.
why_it_matters.korean: 책임이 불분명하면 회사 갈등이 더 커질 수 있다.

parties.label: HYBE and ADOR
parties.english: They said the contracts followed Korean standards and involved negotiations.
parties.korean: 계약이 한국 기준을 따랐고 협상이 있었다고 말했다.

parties.label: Min Hee-jin's representatives
parties.english: They said HYBE's legal team led the drafting and revisions.
parties.korean: 하이브 법무팀이 초안과 수정을 이끌었다고 말했다.

parties.label: NewJeans members
parties.english: They signed the agreements in 2022 while all five were minors.
parties.korean: 다섯 멤버 모두 미성년일 때 2022년에 계약했다.

views.label: HYBE
views.english: HYBE says the agreements included protections for sleep, education, rest, and personal rights.
views.korean: 하이브는 수면, 교육, 휴식, 인권 보호가 있었다고 말한다.

views.label: Min Hee-jin's side
views.english: Her representatives say HYBE's legal department prepared and revised the contracts.
views.korean: 민희진 측은 하이브 법무팀이 계약을 만들고 고쳤다고 말한다.

disagree.english: The dispute remains over who controlled drafting and whether the terms adequately protected minors.
disagree.korean: 초안 주도권과 미성년자 보호 수준을 두고 다툼이 남았다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 어린 연예인은 더 강한 계약 보호를 받아야 할까요?

cards.english_title: Chery Recalls 53,882 Cars Over Rear-Axle Welding Defect
cards.korean_desc: 중국 규제기관은 2026년 11월 체리 차량을 리콜한다고 말했다. 결함은 2022년과 2023년 생산 차량의 뒷차축 용접이다. 심하면 바퀴 조종을 잃고 충돌 위험이 커진다. 체리 회장은 말레이시아 축 사고 뒤 사과했다.
cards.english_desc: China’s market regulator said Chery will recall 53,882 vehicles starting later in November 2026. The defect involves rear-axle welds on Tiggo 5x and Omoda vehicles made during 2022 and 2023. In extreme cases, the problem could cause loss of wheel control and raise crash risks. Chery’s chair apologized after an Omoda rear axle detached in Malaysia.
cards.hook: Chery will recall 53,882 vehicles over a welding defect.
cards.takeaway_english: The recall’s effectiveness will depend on how quickly affected vehicles are repaired.
cards.takeaway_korean: 리콜 효과는 수리가 얼마나 빠른지에 달렸다.

why_it_matters.english: A rear-axle failure can affect wheel control and increase crash risk.
why_it_matters.korean: 뒷차축 고장은 조종과 충돌 위험에 영향을 준다.

why_it_matters.english: Owners need clear recall information for potentially affected vehicles.
why_it_matters.korean: 차량 소유자는 분명한 리콜 정보를 받아야 한다.

parties.label: 체리
parties.english: It will recall vehicles with a rear-axle welding defect.
parties.korean: 체리는 뒷차축 용접 결함 차량을 리콜한다.

parties.label: 중국 시장 규제기관
parties.english: It announced the recall after the defect was identified.

parties.label: 차량 소유자
parties.english: They face a possible loss of wheel control in extreme cases.
parties.korean: 차량 소유자는 바퀴 조종을 잃을 수 있다.

views.label: Regulator and company
views.english: A recall is intended to remove a safety risk from affected vehicles.
views.korean: 리콜은 해당 차량의 안전 위험을 줄이려는 조치다.

views.label: Safety critics
views.english: The Malaysian axle detachment has raised concern about quality control.
views.korean: 말레이시아 사고는 품질 관리 우려를 키웠다.

disagree.english: The recall addresses the listed vehicles, but the available reports do not establish the wider scale of the problem.
disagree.korean: 리콜 대상은 분명하지만 전체 문제 규모는 알 수 없다.

cards.reader_question_korean: 심각한 결함 뒤 업체는 무엇을 알려야 할까요?

sentences.english: In extreme cases, the problem could cause loss of wheel control and raise crash risks.
sentences.korean: 심하면 바퀴 조종을 잃고 충돌 위험이 커진다.

sentences.english: Chery’s chair apologized after an Omoda rear axle detached in Malaysia.
sentences.korean: 체리 회장은 말레이시아 축 사고 뒤 사과했다.

cards.short_english: China’s market regulator said Chery will recall 53,882 vehicles starting later in November 2026.
cards.short_korean: 중국 규제기관은 2026년 11월 체리 차량을 리콜한다고 말했다.
